replies.author: MorbilyABeast
replies.body: Im a 3d artist by profession and think very carefully about optimization and how models are made. These are the biggest hangups for crowds. And ai wont really help in this regard if you want a lot of units on the screen. Unless you can optimize them personally and maybe get claude to implement the models into a tool like Niagara or other crowd solutions that exist. But you will have issues if it involves nodes as ai is bad with this and hinders progress. Try and find a crowd sim solution in pure code. Thats what I would do if I started right now. But I started before this stuff existed and obsessed over optimization the models themselves and just let the engine limit me.
